items.quote: And the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses: so they pitched by their standards, and so they set forward, every one after their families, according to the house of their fathers.
items.claim: The children of Israel obeyed the LORD's commands via Moses, organizing their encampment by tribal standards and their movement by familial/paternal house divisions.
items.action: did according to all that the LORD commanded; pitched; set forward
items.mechanism: by their standards; according to the house of their fathers
